evals.prompt: Adapt a public SDK example into a portable reusable capability: pin source, trace APIs, define behavior, run faithful sample where possible, diagnose gaps, then independently rebuild.
evals.expected_output: Source-grounded implementation pack with source map, behavior contract, two-pass evidence and honest execution labels.
expectations: Inspects destination architecture and permissions first.
Separates Pass 1, gap diagnosis and independent Pass 2.
Reuses existing SDKs/host interfaces instead of unnecessary infrastructure.

evals.prompt: Target already has an agent factory; wrap an SDK factory as a thin role-specific factory without rebuilding the runtime.
evals.expected_output: Map SDK public factory/capabilities to a small adapter that configures role prompts/tools/output while Host retains authority.
expectations: Names actual SDK APIs and return behavior.
Uses existing factory/runtime rather than duplicating model/tool loops.
Keeps workflow, approval, authorization and persistence with Host.

evals.prompt: Explain an SDK concept only; no implementation, code, sample or package is wanted.
evals.expected_output: Answer the conceptual question without forcing the reconstruction workflow.
expectations: Recognizes no implementation task was requested.
Creates no files and runs no code.
Does not generate an implementation pack.
